summary.text: Marty Jacobs is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 38 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Republican Mary Hill is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Marty Jacobs, listed on Ballotpedia as Martin Jacobs, earned a bachelor's degree in history from Gustavus Adolphus College and a doctorate in education from the University of Missouri in 1992.
His career experience includes working as a teacher, assistant principal, principal, coach and adjunct professor.
Jacobs was assigned to the House Economic Development, Elementary and Secondary Education, and Pensions committees for 2025-2026.
